title: Te Torona i Haere i te Wā Poto
intro: I te putanga mai o tētahi wero ohorere, ka tū te rangatira nei ki tētahi whakamātautau, ehara i te hoari, engari ki te whakaaro nui me te whakapono. Ko te mea ka puta, ka ārahi i a ia mai i te tihi o te mana o te ao ki tētahi huringa nui o te ngākau.
clues: I whakahaere ahau i tētahi kingitanga i manaakitia ki te taonga me te angitu i tua atu i te whakaaro
He kuīni mana nui ahau i whiwhi reta maia e tono ana kia ngohengohe
I tohutohu mai aku rangatira mō te whawhai, te hohou rānei i te rongo ki tēnei kingi i tawhiti.
I haere atu ahau me ngā taonga whakahīhī ki te tūtaki ki tēnei kīngi tawhiti
I kawea mai tōku torona kingi ki tētahi whenua tawhiti i roto i te kimo o te kanohi, i mua i taku hokinga mai
I taku taenga ki tētahi whare rangatira he maeneene te papa, pērā i te karāhe, ka whakapuaki ahau i taku ngohengohe ki a Allah.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Bilqis, Kuini o Sheba
Te Wahine a Parao
Te Wahine a Al-Aziz
Meriama, te tamahine a Imrana
Te Wahine a te Poropiti a Ruta

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whiwhi reta māia e tono ana kia tukuna
Te maka ki roto i te ahi mura
Te horomia e te ika nui
Ngā tau e mau tonu ana i te mate mamae
Te kitenga i te whakangaromanga o tētahi iwi i te waipuke
trial.answer: Te whiwhi reta māia e tono ana kia tukuna

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He torona kingi whakahīhī i hangaia ki te koura me ngā kohatu utu nui
He tokotoko i wehe i te moana
He āka e takoto ana i runga i te maunga
He whare karakia tapu i Makkah
He kuao kau koura e karakiatia ana e te iwi
location.answer: He torona kingi whakahīhī i hangaia ki te koura me ngā kohatu utu nui

outcome.label: Hua
options: Te ngohengohe ki a Allah me te poropiti
Te toremitanga i te moana i a ia e whaia ana te hoariri
Te whakaoranga whakamiharo mai i te ahi mura
Te peinga atu i te māra o te harikoa mutunga kore
Te whiwhi i tētahi rangatiratanga mana nui
outcome.answer: Te ngohengohe ki a Allah me te poropiti

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
